# Data Types

Choose a type for each value in the record. For payments, start with `Number`
for amounts, `Category` for merchants, and `Boolean` for dispute labels.
A `Branch` groups repeated transactions. Leaf types are also called
**tensorfields**.

## Available Types

| Value | Type |
| --- | --- |
| Payment amount, balance, or days since a transaction | [Number](../data-types/number.qmd) |
| Whether a payment was disputed | [Boolean](../data-types/boolean.qmd) |
| Merchant category learned from training labels | [Category](../data-types/category.qmd) |
| Recent transactions, each with its own fields | [Branch](../data-types/branch.qmd) |
| Payment channel from a declared fixed set | [Enum](../data-types/enum.qmd) |
| Unordered transaction tags | [Set](../data-types/set.qmd) |
| Recurring calendar position of a payment timestamp | [DateParts](../data-types/dateparts.qmd) |
| Account identifier equality without a learned vocabulary | [Hash](../data-types/hash.qmd) |
| Amount represented by its learned distribution | [Quantile](../data-types/quantile.qmd) |
| Merchant labels sharing learned latent groups | [Group](../data-types/group.qmd) |
| Supplied numeric representation | [Vector](../data-types/vector.qmd) |
| Meaning of a payment description from a frozen text encoder | [Text](../data-types/text.qmd) |

Choose by meaning rather than storage format: a numeric merchant code is
usually a Category. Unordered tags belong in a Set; transactions with amounts
and dates belong in a Branch.

Category, Set, and Group learn labels through an
[online vocabulary](vocabulary.qmd). Its capacity, admission timing, and unknown
values affect both training and prediction.
Enum uses the labels declared in its schema and rejects values outside that set.

## Value state {#value-state}

State describes a position; content carries its value. They are separate model
inputs, so zero content does not have to mean null or padding.

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `valued` | A source value exists, including zero, false, empty strings, and empty sets. |
| `null` | The source explicitly contains null. |
| `padded` | The fixed schema geometry has no source position. |
| `masked` | An input has been replaced by a learned mask representation. |
| `other` | Reserved for extension-defined states; ordinary built-in inputs do not produce it. |

One record can contain both empty and null sets:

```yaml
recent_transactions:
  - merchant: grocery
    tags: []
  - merchant: cafe
    tags: null
```

With a branch length greater than two, unused transaction positions are padded.
The first `tags` value is valued; the second is null. Structurally skipped
inputs use separate presence information rather than a sixth state token.

An unknown Category is still valued; its categorical content is unavailable.
Unknown Set members simply have no active vocabulary bit. Neither case is
null. Keep one compatible Arrow value family per identity field: strings,
binary values, integers, floats, and Booleans are distinct families. Number,
Quantile, and Vector allow integer/float promotion. Datatypes own these contracts;
[custom tensorfields](../guides/custom-tensorfields.qmd) can declare their own.

## Shared leaf options {#shared-leaf-options}

The parent names a field with `amount=rf.Number(...)`. Definitions have no
`name` argument. Use a `fields` mapping for generated schemas or names that
collide with configuration, and `description` for notes. Undeclared options
are rejected.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `None` | Read the parent's same-named child; an explicit [query](querypaths.qmd) selects another structural path. |
| `description` | `None` | Human-readable meaning or units. |
| `active` | `True` | Inactive leaves remain in the schema but do not encode, train, or predict. |
| `nullable` | `True` | Whether explicit nulls are allowed in the projected input. |
| `mask` | `False` | Visibility and reconstruction policies; see [Masking](dynamic-masking.qmd). |
| `weight` | `1.0` | Positive multiplier on this field's total loss. |
| `embed` | `False` | Export a normalized contextual embedding during prediction. |
| `pooling` | `"query"` | Decoder context pooling: `"query"` or `"mean"`. |
| `n_heads` | `4` | Positive, even query-pooling head count; attention requires it to divide `d_model` with at least two dimensions per head. |
| `ffnx` | `8` | Positive integer feed-forward multiplier for this field's query decoder and aligned context projection. See [model-tree configuration](model-tree.qmd#configure-the-context). |
| `dropout` | `None` | Optional query-pooling dropout in `[0, 1)`. |
| `n_linear` | `1` | Positive number of learned-query decoder pooling blocks. |
| `decoder_position` | `None` | Automatic: off for scalar targets, on for repeated targets. A Boolean overrides it. |

These are the ordinary constructor defaults. Model
[size factories](model-tree.qmd#choose-a-size) supply omitted decoder settings
from their preset; explicit field options take precedence.

`mask=True` makes a supervised target. [Masking](dynamic-masking.qmd) owns the
other policies, including sampled reconstruction and branch selection.
`embed=True` exports a representation; it does not create an objective.

## What predictions contain

Decoded fields share `state` probabilities and a Boolean `inferred` flag.
`inferred` marks requested reconstruction, not confidence. Each datatype owns
its remaining payload:

| Type | Decoded content |
| --- | --- |
| Number | Scalar in source units |
| Quantile | Scalar in source units; null before learning a distribution |
| Boolean | Probability of true |
| Category, Enum | Best label, probability, and optional candidates |
| Group | Best group and best vocabulary label, each with probability |
| Set | Label/probability pairs |
| Vector | Fixed-width reconstructed vector |
| DateParts, Hash, Text | No decoded public payload |

All types can export an embedding when configured. These vectors live in the
separate `representations` column, with paths
and ancestor coordinates. Branches export context embeddings but never decode a
typed branch value. See
[Embeddings](embeddings.qmd) for representation roles and
[Prediction output](../guides/prediction-output.qmd) for Arrow shapes and access.
